language.description: The language the question was about — the `detectionQuestion` of `GET .../sessions/:sessionId/response-language`.

answer.description: `confirm` stores it as your detected-and-confirmed language (it then answers you wherever your Account is on automatic); 409 `deteccao_mudou` when your messages no longer point to it. `decline` stores the refusal and this language is never asked again (confirming it later clears the refusal).
